BULLOCK_2016.scope: Original MNXL lysine/N-terminal benchmark with11.4 angstrom reagents; mu18.62, variance35.94, cutoff33 and negative penalties. The v3.3 zero-above-cutoff positive-component adaptation is separately labelled.

PGK_2025_TABLE_S2.scope: Six literal DSBU XP coefficient rows in supplementary TableS2; source-specific modeling convention.

PGK_2025.scope: DSBU experiments and endpoint/search context; search allowance is not identification validation.

SUPPLIED_SITARIK_ED8.scope: Supplied literal six-row table; numbers match PGK2025 TableS2.

NCLEDETECTOR_9E3D4ED_SCORE_XL.scope: Source generalized algebra only; presence of a residue length is not proof of chemical reactivity.

THERMO_DSSO_DSBU.scope: MS-cleavable amine-reactive reagents; spacer lengths do not supply Gaussian calibration.
THERMO_DSSO_DSBU.reconciliation: Legacy v3.1/v3.2 used DSSO 10.1 angstrom. New v3.3 exploratory transfers explicitly use this manufacturer's 10.3 angstrom convention; historical results are not changed.

THERMO_EDC.scope: Carboxyl-to-amine zero-length coupling; no XP mean/SD inferred.

THERMO_MALEIMIDE.scope: Free sulfhydryl endpoints; occupied cysteine thiols are not assumed available.

THERMO_SDA.scope: Amine anchor and activated photoreactive capture; broad photo reactivity is conditional, not universally validated.

NHS_STY_2009.scope: Conditional hydroxyl reactivity of NHS esters; no universal pair calibration.

NHS_LOCALIZATION_2023.scope: NHS nonprimary-site assignment and localization require spectrum-level assessment; this source marker does not itself validate a candidate.

DIAZIRINE_SELECTIVITY.scope: Photoreactive selectivity and activation are condition dependent; no generic site-specific quantitative model is supplied.

XLMOD_CV.scope: Reagent identity and chemistry vocabulary only; not a fitted XP table.

RELINK_SEARCH_CONFIGURATION.scope: NonCovalentBound search designation is retained separately from covalent crosslink evidence.
